title: Signal: Set-Cookie Max-Age is not a valid integer
scope: One Set-Cookie header whose Max-Age attribute value is not a run of digits.
limitations: One header value. The rule validates the attribute token and never decides whether the cookie is a session cookie; a browser that ignores the attribute applies its own fallback, which the observation cannot show.

headers.Set-Cookie: sid=abc; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=one-hour
sid=abc; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=
sid=abc; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=3600

fpNotes: A malformed Max-Age is still flagged when Expires carries the intended lifetime; the finding is the unparsable attribute, not a specific expiry date.
